title: Ex-post evaluation of the 2007-2013 Northern Ireland Rural Development Programme (NIRDP)
file_title: 2007-2013 NIRDP Ex-post Evaluation Adobe PDF (3.43 MB)
description: This document describes a comprehensive evaluation of three rural development initiatives in Northern Ireland: the Northern Ireland Rural Development Programme (NIRDP) 2007-2013, the PMG Scheme, and various agricultural modernization programs. The NIRDP aimed to improve rural areas through agricultural, environmental, and economic initiatives, and was found to be largely effective, with recommendations for future policies. The evaluation used a mix of research methods and found that the program met its goals, enhancing competitiveness and productivity in agriculture, supporting sustainable land management, and promoting economic diversification. The PMG Scheme, focused on supporting small enterprises in agri-food and forestry, was also successful, with a third of applicants receiving funding and positive impacts on competitiveness and environmental outcomes. Other programs, such as the Farm Modernisation Programme and the Supply Chain Development Programme, contributed to modernization, environmental benefits, and industry cooperation. Overall, these initiatives were found to provide value for money and positively impact rural communities in Northern Ireland.
